messages:
Maya Patel: quick check — novaX_7b weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/novaX/7b/safetensors/ ; can someone run packaging smoke test?

Samir Khan: I converted to safetensors + fp16 this morning. shard layout is TP-friendly but there's a fq edge case w/ tokenizer special tokens. small note: tokenizer.json has 'unk_token' missing.

Liam O'Neill: can you paste the exact s3 path? I'll run the validator.

Samir Khan: path above. validator cmd: `python tools/validate_checkpoint.py --model-dir s3://redwood-models/novaX/7b/safetensors --tp 2 --dtype fp16`

Nina Gomez: validator flagged mismatch in config.json: `hidden_size` vs layout expectations. quick diff: `config.json: 'n_head': 32` vs our tp-split expects divisible by 16. attaching snippet.

Samir Khan: log: ```ERROR: shard_1: tensor shape (32, 4096) not divisible by tp=2``` I resequenced sharding but still see off-by-one in last shard.

Patrick Wu: common cause is tokenizer adding BOS token in different order. Samir can you run `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/novaX/7b/tokenizer/tokenizer.json`

Samir Khan: done. tokenizer script reports special tokens: {'bos': null, 'eos': '', 'unk': null} — missing bos/unk. I'll patch tokenizer and re-run sharding.

Infra Bot: build pipeline #packaging-985 completed — safetensors pack step succeeded for shards 0..3 (duration 4m). :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel: thanks. once patched, can we also export bf16 variant for Dedicated tests? request: bf16 for perf baseline.

Samir Khan: yes. conversion pipeline supports `--dtype bf16`. note: bf16 + TP requires kernel compatibility check — see internal KB: https://redwood.internal/eng-ml/quant-kernels (internal link).

Liam O'Neill: pinging @Nina Gomez for config review - can you approve the config changes in PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/421

Nina Gomez: review done, left 2 small comments about `rotary_dim` inference. not blocking. :thumbsup:

Patrick Wu: I'll schedule a quick canary on dedicated cluster after bf16 build. ETA 2h.

Maya Patel: perfect. Samir, reassign to me when ready and I'll trigger the canary. :rocket:
